title: 1709 Prairie: a brick stable by the tracks, with carriage doors
items: The plain block behind 1709 Prairie, by the Illinois Central tracks, is now a storey-and-a-half brick stable: carriage doors, a man door and stable windows face the house's yard, a loft hatch is in its south gable, and a fire wall stands on the lot line with 1701. The outline is the 1911 fire-insurance map's, and an 1886 atlas marks a brick stable in the same place. The doors, windows and roof are reconstructed.
